messages:
maya: Quick sync: final social microplan for Microlaunch next week. Need 15s hook, stat card, and two canned replies (webinar vs demo). Also want a small test: pinned reply = demo clip vs stat card.

sahil: Uploaded 15s hook + stat PNG to drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/microlaunch/hook15. Exported 1:1 and 9:16.

maya: can you burn captions on the 15s for story posts? many watch muted.

sahil: yep will do captions and a 6s cut for reel.

ana: Copy variants in doc. Suggestion: use metric-led headline on X and developer-led on LinkedIn. Drafted two threaded outlines for LI: tease -> benchmark highlight -> product angle -> CTA.

maya: good. we'll A/B pinned reply on X NA only for 24h: Group A pinned demo clip, Group B pinned stat card. Track CTR/bookings.

ryan: routing set: /microlaunch?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=microlaunch_q2&utm_region={REGION}&utm_variant={VARIANT}. Demo bookings append &intent=demo. Webhook sends leads to HubSpot with tag social:microlaunch.

maya: engagement ops: SDRs to reply within 2 hours. Two canned replies: 1) "Thanks! Short demo: <clip>. Book 15m: <link>." 2) "Webinar signup: <webinar link>." Ryan put both in the shared doc.

engage-bot: Reminder set: post drafts due Fri 17:00 PT to #marketing-assets. A/B test window: Mon 10:00 PT -> Tue 10:00 PT.

maya: paid boost plan: APAC story clips for 48 hrs with gated benchmark PDF behind email capture. Make sure PDF headline matches social stat (95ms median / 3x cost).

ana: gating note done. I'll add FAQ pinned comment for LI about enterprise pricing and escalation steps to sales@redwood.com.

ryan: analytics: will create dashboard measuring CTR, demo bookings, webinar signups, and gated PDF downloads per variant/region.

sahil: captions done, assets ready.

maya: blockers?

ana: none.

ryan: none.

maya: tidy. final tone pass tomorrow AM then we schedule. :rocket:
